jobs.occupation: Service and Project Engineer Building Technologies
jobs.description:
Within the division Building Technologies the role of the service & start-up engineer contains task of After sales service, preventive Maintenance, the follow-up of interventions and the optimalisation of customer installations.
 

Services:
 
 

• Permanent co-working with the internal teams of planning and management 

• Ensuring the maintenance of plants at customers according to the rules of the art and in function of the company's processes 

• Responsible for troubleshooting and Intervention on HVAC applications within Belgium 

• Operational assistance for the contracts from the office or in the field 

• Providing assistance as well as a positive support to the customers 

• Actively cooperate with the Center or Competences and the project department 

• Support to the Division "Sales" 

• Communicate efficiently with the entire organization 

• Provide support and help to other Service Engineers and Supervisors for their tasks on customer contracts. 

• Development of the company's business.  

Projects:
 
 

• Clarifying issues with the Engineering department 

• Analyses and programming of the different Systems of the product range 

• Perform I/O tests on the field 

• Ensure a qualitative start-up in commissioning faze 

• Working in close collaboration with the project manager 
 

• Degree: Bachelor or Master in Klimatisatie/Acclimatisation, Energy or equivalent through experience 

• Languages: Dutch/French/English 

• Expertise in the field of Commissioning and Control of HVAC installations or willing to learn (starters welcome)

• Affinity with energy management and alternative energy sources 

• Knowledge of Microsoft Office and databases

• Communication skills, both written and oral 

• Possess good writing and spelling skills 

• Customer focused 

• Flexible

• Commercial set

As a logistical inventory specialist, you strengthen the team of order pickers at Kuehne+Nagel in Geel working in 2 shifts for €16,3753/hour and meal vouchers.

You fulfill a versatile key position as a logistical inventory specialist, combining the physical order picking of famous toy products with the administrative follow-up of inventory and quality controls. Thanks to your sharp eye and accurate way of working, your contribution as a logistical inventory specialist guarantees a flawless logistical process.

Ready to take the next step as an order picker? Aply via talentcenter1@randstad.be or 011 54 92 85!

VG 458/BUOSAP

Who are we looking for?

• At least 6 months of demonstrable experience within the logistics sector.
• Practical experience with a hand scanner and administrative follow-up.
• Good command of either the Dutch or English language.
• Willingness to work in a 2-shift system.
• Possession of your own transport to reach the location in Geel.
Key responsibilities

• Physically collecting toy goods and orders using a hand scanner.
• Performing thorough quality checks on picked orders from colleague order pickers.
• Monitoring stock levels and supporting warehouse administration.
• Spotting and correcting inventory discrepancies at an early stage.

Join Kuehne+Nagel in Geel as an experienced order picker and earn €16,3753/hour plus €8 meal vouchers working in a 2-shift system!

In this varied role, you will combine active order picking with quality control and warehouse administration. You will ensure top quality for renowned brands and make sure every shipment is in perfect condition.

Ready to take the next step in your logistics career? Send your CV to talentcenter1@randstad.be or call us directly at 011 54 92 85!

VG 458/BUOSA

What are we looking for in a candidate?

• Minimum of 6 months to 1 year of experience in a warehouse setting or order picking.
• Proven experience working with a handheld scanner is required.
• Good command of either Dutch or English.
• Willing to work in a 2-shift rotation on a long-term basis.
• Must have your own transport to commute to the site in Geel.
Your main duties as an order picker:

• Order picking goods in the warehouse using a handheld scanner.
• Conducting accurate quality control checks on picked orders.
• Checking and monitoring physical inventory and stock discrepancies.
• Handling the required warehouse administration within the system.
• Reporting deviations and safeguarding overall quality standards.

jobs.occupation: Inside sales | German market | 100% on site in Antwerp
jobs.description:
As an Inside Sales Representative, you will take ownership of the German market, developing new business opportunities and building long-term customer relationships. You will join a dynamic, international family-owned company in the food industry, where initiative, commercial drive and results are highly valued.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Our client is a well-established international company operating within the food sector. With a family-business mindset, entrepreneurial spirit, and strong growth ambitions, they offer a fast-paced environment where initiative and results are highly valued.

Omschrijving

•  Proactively identify and develop new business opportunities within the German market.
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers and prospects.
• Manage the full sales cycle, from lead generation to closing deals.
• Conduct commercial negotiations and follow up on sales opportunities.
• Expand the customer portfolio and strengthen market presence.
• Analyze sales performance and market trends.
• Report on sales activities and contribute to the overall sales strategy.
 

•  Fluent in German and English, knowledge of Dutch or additional languages is a strong asset.
• Previous experience in sales, business development, or a commercial role.
• Strong commercial acumen and a results-oriented mindset.
• A true go-getter with the drive to open new doors and create opportunities.
• Confident communicator with excellent relationship-building skills.
• Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to learn.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Affinity with the food industry is an advantage.
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is a plus.

Antwerp Convention Bureau (ACB – www.antwerpconventionbureau.be) focuses on promoting the city of Antwerp as a premium destination for meetings, incentives, conferences, exhibitions, and events (MICE). Their brand promise is ‘The city is your venue’. Antwerp Convention Bureau highlights the diverse range of conference facilities in Antwerp and builds strong local expertise to support conference organizers and attendees in hosting conferences and business activities within the city.
The goal is to use a comprehensive marketing strategy and a proactive approach to attract international B-2-B events for associations or the industry that generate a positive impact on the residents, entrepreneurs, and visitors of the city of Antwerp. These events reinforce local and regional policies because they are linked to strong economic clusters, knowledge institutions, or centers of expertise.
In order to expand its organization and network, Antwerp Convention Bureau is actively seeking a new Managing Director.

Jobomschrijving

As Managing Director, you are the driving force behind the long-term strategy and financial performance of the organisation. Taking full P&L responsibility, you safeguard the financial health and ensure a maximum return on investment for the allocated budgets. You build on the current momentum by prioritizing the structuring of the organisation, implementing clear processes, and inspiring the internal team. Furthermore, you act as the primary local and international ambassador who proudly carries the bureau's successes to the city and its stakeholders, further shaping its vision within the meeting and convention (MICE) industry. 
As Managing Director, you will be responsible for:

• Managing human and financial resources efficiently within the allocated budgets while meeting the city's KPI’s.
• Coaching, motivating, and guiding the team to perform at their maximum potential, ensuring clear roles and responsibilities.
• Maintaining a strong and proactive network of relationships with the financing government, local stakeholders, and various players within the industry.
• Reporting on operations and milestones to the Executive Board.
• Representing ACB with strong communication skills. Expanding the (inter)national network within the highly competitive meeting industry. Simultaneously, you showcase local successes and act as the public face of the organization fostering the local public relations (PR), translating achievements into pride for the city and local stakeholders. 
• Leading the day-to-day management and further development of the organisation in line with the long-term strategy, ensuring the implementation of clear procedures, best practices, and an optimal organisational structure.

You are first and foremost an organisation builder and a true people manager who provides your team with direction, clarity, and structure. Additionally, you are a business-minded networker who effortlessly represents the organisation and inspires others during presentations and networking events. You possess a strategic approach paired with innovative thinking, and you show great diplomatic sensitivity towards the interests of local stakeholders.
Additionally, you possess:

• A Master’s degree (or equivalent working and thinking level), coupled with substantial experience in setting up, structuring, and leading a solid organisation at a senior management level.
• Strong PR skills and a proven track record of local stakeholder management, successfully communicating results to government, partners, ambassadors, the team and other stakeholders.
• A background in the (inter)national hospitality industry, or experience as a senior business marketing and sales professional within a highly competitive international sector. Experience within the MICE sector is considered a strong asset, though leadership skills are prioritized.
• A strict commitment to being based in Antwerp alongside a readiness to travel internationally.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills in both Dutch and English.

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated individual to join our accounting team. As an 
Accounts Payable Specialist, you will play a crucial role in the creation and execution of our Accounts Payable 2.0 processes, transitioning from manual invoice processing to automated workflows, with a focus on KPI reporting, efficiency enhancement, and transparency. The ideal candidate will have excellent analytical skills, advanced proficiency in Excel and SAP.
 

This role will address existing challenges, establish robust processes, and ensure the accurate and timely processing of all AP flows.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Test and implement new or updated vendor invoice management systems. 

• Develop and implement effective processes and KPIs to streamline and monitor manual tasks. 

• Implement critical checkpoints for automatically posted invoices to ensure accuracy and efficiency. 

• Collaborate with Logistics and Purchasing teams to identify opportunities for improvement and increase the number of automatically processed invoices. 

• Create and maintain full Procure-to-Pay (P2P) reporting using advanced Excel and SAP knowledge. 

• Provide guidance and training to the accounting team to bridge knowledge gaps and improve overall team efficiency. 

• Foster transparency in operational processes, vendor balances, and dispute resolutions.  

 

 

• Proven experience in accounts payable or a similar accounting role with a focus on process improvement. 

• Advanced proficiency in Excel and intermediate SAP knowledge. 

• Strong communication skills in English. 

• Analytical skills to design and implement checks for automation in the P2P process. 

• Ability to lead and collaborate with cross-functional and international teams. 

• Detail-oriented, with strong organizational and time management skills. 

• Ability to adapt to a dynamic work environment and drive positive change.

Historically recognized as the global benchmark for premium retail equipment and trolley manufacturing, 
Wanzl has successfully evolved into a 
total solutions provider optimizing customer experiences.
 

To support the ambitious course in Belgium and Luxembourg, Wanzl is looking for an entrepreunerial Business Development Manager.  This role is pivotal in driving the new era, turning premium product innovations and digital solutions into sustainable market share.
 

As Business Development Manager, you act as 'co-architect' of the business transformation in BeLux, supporting the General Manager. You combine traditional sales with high-level strategic business development to gain market share with new, digital, and automated solutions. You pioneer new growth areas while further expanding existing strategic partnerships.
 
 

• You further design and implement a sustainable go-to-market strategy to successfully position the renewed Wanzl portfolio in the market. 

• You take responsibility for major, existing key accounts in retail and proactively expand the C-level relationship network within complex Decision Making Units. 

• You actively identify market opportunities for product innovations (such as digital retail and automation solutions) and lead the acquisition process from A to Z, including complex price negotiations. 

• You implement structured and data-driven sales management (CRM, forecasting, and account planning) to achieve commercial performance and strict P&L and margin targets. 

• You work closely with the local sales and operational teams and the international headquarters to guarantee an optimal customer journey and efficient collaboration. 
 

• You hold a university degree and have 10 to 15 years of proven successful B2B sales and business development experience, preferably in retail or other relevant sector. 

• You are accustomed to operating in highly competitive markets and have experience managing complex key accounts. 

• You combine a strong commercial and entrepreneurial mindset with analytical skills and a P&L and margin focus, capable of translating data into concrete actions. 

• You have a proactive hands-on mentality and enjoy taking independent initiative to drive the business forward. 

• You communicate convincingly at various levels and are fluent in Dutch and French (required for the local market), as well as English (communications with HQ and other affiliates). Knowledge of German is a nice plus.

Our client is a leading international law firm with a strong reputation for excellence and a collaborative working environment. To support its Brussels office, the firm is looking for a highly organised and proactive Legal Secretary.

Jobomschrijving

As a Legal Secretary, you will provide comprehensive administrative support to a team of lawyers and contribute to the smooth running of the office. Your responsibilities will include:

• Agenda management, organisation of meetings en events.
• Coordinating travel arrangements.
• Handling calls, emails and correspondence.
• Preparing, formatting and proofreading legal documents, presentations, reports and correspondence.
• Supporting billing processes and expense reporting.
• Working closely with colleagues across the Brussels and international offices to ensure seamless support.

• You have at least 2 years of experience in an administrative, Legal Assistant, Management Assistant or Executive Assistant role.
• Experience within a legal or professional services environment is an asset.
• You are fluent in English, French is a plus
• You have excellent organisational skills and strong attention to detail.
• You can manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high level of accuracy and professionalism.
• You are proactive, adaptable and able to work both independently and as part of a team.

jobs.occupation: Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering Data Centres
jobs.description:
As a Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, you coordinate the entire engineering and design process. You monitor the technical scope, planning and engineering budget, ensuring that the different disciplines work together towards one integrated design.

• Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams within complex data centre projects

• Manage the technical scope, engineering budget and associated contract documentation

• Prepare and monitor the engineering schedule and allocate tasks within the team

• Coordinate the different technical disciplines and ensure alignment between their designs

• Coordinate collaboration between Belgian and international engineering teams

• Work closely with external consultants, contractors and other technical partners

• Review technical design decisions and challenge or adjust them where necessary

• Manage design changes and assess their impact on the overall project

• Translate complex client requirements into technically feasible solutions

• Present and discuss technical concepts with clients and project teams

• Remain involved during the execution phase and act as a technical point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders

For the position of Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, we are looking for someone who combines strong technical knowledge with excellent coordination skills. Experience within data centres is an advantage, but experience with industrial buildings or other technically complex building projects can also be a strong match.

• You hold a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical discipline

• You have at least 5 years of experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering or design projects

• You have experience leading and coordinating engineers and other technical stakeholders

• You are familiar with complex technical building installations and multidisciplinary engineering

• Experience with data centres, industrial buildings or other complex built environments is a strong advantage

• You are familiar with digital engineering processes, 3D design and BIM environments

• You have a good understanding of relevant standards, regulations and working methods within engineering and construction

• You communicate effectively with engineers, consultants, contractors and clients

• English knowledge is a must, Dutch and French are a plus

Relevant experience is essential for this position. We are specifically looking for candidates who have previously worked in a similar role, coordinating multidisciplinary engineering or design projects within data centres, industrial buildings or other technically complex environments.

If you do not have relevant experience in a comparable position or project environment, we kindly ask you not to apply for this vacancy.
